scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @creative-marketer/contracts && npm run build --workspace @creative-marketer/web
scripts.contracts:generate: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && cd ../.. && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated.ts && prettier --write packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
